text: All right, so you walk up to a couple of marines who are staying there.
I walk up and go, excuse me, officers, if I may call you that?
Is there any reason why you're patrolling the docks?
I feel as if your guys' presence, there must be something awry.
Captain orders to have a detachment down here.
Apparently there was some bloodshed a night ago or so.
In a place called the Chart Room.
Apparently, however, the men that killed them were a little bit more skilled than many.
Oh my goodness, are we okay?
That puts me more at ease.
If I could ask you one last thing.
I lost my company of who I was working for, and I have no idea how to travel and trade
I am a merchant and I've been trying to trade back to Monmurg, of all places, to get some more goods.
I just, I figured I would at least try and get some stuff back here.
I've heard that there is a new dock opening up in Saltmarsh if you want to go there.
Or you can take your wares to Seton.
There are ships that go there if you'd like.
This place is a lot safer with you around.
We don't want those foreign spies to cause any more trouble.
And I shake his hand, but it's very limp.
